description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Holy with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Knight Mode I (Beatrix)] and [Knight Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking

description.name: Dual Awoken Knight Mode I (Beatrix)
